description: Elasticsearch / Kibana connector (read-only, Tier-3 metadata-only). Surfaces the user's Elasticsearch indices as `elasticsearch:index` items in the local index — the index name, health (green/yellow/red), status (open/close), document COUNT, store size in bytes, primary-shard and replica counts, UUID, and the index's field names + types from its mapping (SCHEMA metadata). Useful for answering operational/schema questions ("which indices are red?", "what fields does the orders index have?", "how big is the logs-2026.05 index?") without leaving Nimbus. This is a NO-ROW-DATA (Tier-3) connector: it indexes index METADATA only and NEVER document contents — it does not call `_search`, `_doc`, `_mget`, `_sql`, `_scroll`, or any endpoint that returns document SOURCE. Elasticsearch API-key auth (sent as the `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` request header). Elasticsearch has no universal SaaS host (self-hosted or Elastic Cloud): the cluster host is supplied via the elasticsearch url vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by phase3AddElasticsearchMcp, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. The connector walks `_cat/indices` for the metadata listing and per-index `_mapping` for field names + types, both capped. ES system indices (names starting with `.`) are skipped by default. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
